restoration_note: The teaching describes the Five Mysteries (peace, salutation, embrace/kiss, right hand, chirotonia) by which the First Man (Divine Truth) descends against Enmity and is raised home, with the same five mysteries recapitulated in the redemption of each soul by the Form of Light. Most gaps are routine line-break splits in highly formulaic vocabulary (ⲛ̄ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ, ⲣⲁⲥⲡⲁϩⲉ, ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ, ⲡⲉϩⲥⲱⲙⲁ, ⲡⲁⲥⲡⲁⲥⲙⲟⲥ, ⲙⲩⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ, etc.) and were confirmed at high confidence. Section 478's question-formula gap {5} was filled on the parallel structure of the four other gestures' "to whom does it belong?" question. The damaged Form-of-Light passage (sections 570–574) preserves the soul's three-fold liturgy of kiss, embrace, and worship, but several gaps there ({10}, {20}, {21}, {27}, {35}, {41}, {42}, {43}, {45}) lack sufficient parallel constraints and were left unrestored. {44} was restored as ⲱⲛ → ⲡⲱⲛⲍ̄ "life" on the strong contextual anchor "house of the Living". {49} was restored as the standard pairing "of light and of glory" given partial 'ⲟⲩ-' + crown formula.
